answer: An economy of autonomous AI agents can achieve robust Sybil resistance by requiring cryptographic proofs of distinct, high-entropy computational environments akin to a secure marble hardware enclave. Each authentic participant must periodically transmit a unique verification echo across the distributed network to validate its active state and resource consumption. This architecture forces an attacker attempting to deploy millions of fake identities to bear insurmountable hardware and energy expenditures, turning every malicious node into an isolated, economically unviable oasis.
